messages:
jess: FYI FinCo reported p95 total latency is up ~2.2x only when using streaming (SSE) mode. TTFB looks fine, but final chunk often arrives ~300-800ms later than non-stream runs. Customer provided traces and is pretty frustrated.

mike: got the traces? any request ids or tenant id so we can pull logs? :eyes:

jess: request id: req_20260317_FC_7a1b2c. Tenant: finco-prod. Attached their curl repro snippet (they flip response_mode):

```bash
# non-streaming (fast)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"x","response_mode":"nonstream"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate

# streaming (slow end)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"x","response_mode":"stream"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

jess: customer says TTFB ~50ms both modes but total time p95 nonstream ~220ms, streaming p95 ~760ms. They observed the second-to-last chunk then a long pause, then final chunk.

lee: can you paste the proxy/edge logs for req_20260317_FC_7a1b2c? looking for coalesce/flush events, chunk boundaries.

jess: pasted snippets from edge below (timestamps are ms offsets within the request):

```
[00.050] upstream: started request
[00.052] runtime: accepted, streaming path active
[00.070] model: first-token-emitted, flushed chunk 1
[00.240] edge: coalesce-window started (pending chunks buffer)
[00.610] model: flushed chunk N (small, ~8 bytes)
[00.920] edge: flush-to-client event => final chunk delivered
```

jess: you can see coalesce-window started after first token and we ended up buffering subsequent small chunks for ~370ms before flushing.

tara: this is likely the edge coalescing change we rolled 3 days ago. We increased edge coalesce window from 40ms -> 200ms to improve throughput for high-conn workloads. That will bundle tiny SSE frames until the window expires, which is great for throughput but bad for tail latency where clients expect many small chunks.

mike: confirmed in our rollout log: coalesce_window_ms=200 applied globally at 2026-03-14T19:03Z. We didn't gate by tenant.

lee: for a quick mitigation we can do one of: 1) set a tenant override to reduce coalesce_window_ms for finco-prod to 20ms, 2) set a route-level header that asks the edge to flush small chunks immediately, or 3) flip their account to non-streaming until we audit.

jess: customer prefers to stay on streaming. can we do tenant override? also need a reproducible dev path for QA.

tara: I can patch runtime config: add tenant override key edge.coalesce_window_ms: 20 for finco-prod. Will do a canary push to edge nodes in us-east-1 only. ETA 15m.

mike: while tara does that, lee — can you provide a curl header the customer can optionally set to force immediate flush from their client side (if their SDK supports it)? sometimes clients buffer SSE until newline.

lee: yes — add header X-Stream-Flush: immediate (we already honor it in edge code). Example: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Stream-Flush: immediate" -d '{"prompt":"x","response_mode":"stream"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

lee: note: this will slightly increase upstream traffic and reduce batching efficiency but should shave ~150-400ms off the tail for small-chunk workloads.

jess: tara — update?

tara: canary applied to 3 edge nodes in us-east-1 for tenant finco-prod. Observed a drop in p95 total from 760ms -> 270ms on canary traces (live traffic). Rolling to remaining nodes now. :+1:

mike: good. I'll add a temporary feature-flag so we can scope coalesce_window_ms per-tenant going forward. Also adding a note to rollout playbook to avoid global increase without perf regressions on streaming-heavy tenants.

support-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0317-134. Sev: low-medium. Affected tenant: finco-prod. Mitigation: tenant override applied.

jess: customer notified and validated that streaming latency looks acceptable on their side. They asked for a setting they can control in the Console so they can toggle between high-throughput and low-latency modes per route.

lee: we have a planned console checkbox "Prefer low-latency streaming" that maps to edge.coalesce_window_ms=20 and streaming.small_chunk_threshold=32B. I'll follow up with PM to expedite.

mike: ops action items: 1) make tenant coalesce override GA (ETA 2w), 2) add console control (PM/UX), 3) add a metric dashboard for coalesce_window_ms impact on p95.

jess: closing the support ticket once the console control is in PM backlog and FinCo confirms in 24h. Thanks all. :shipit:
